finalText:
**Redis died, and everything downstream drowned.** One cause, not many.

At `02:14:07` `[api]` logged `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads. Then 174 cache miss storms and 173 `TimeoutError: request timed out after 5000ms`. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 past the 500 max. Redis never came back. 13 reconnect tries, all refused, each 80s apart with no backoff.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost` ([app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)) |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. The app never recovers on its own.
